hero.subtitle1: A beautiful booking page for your clients, a powerful backoffice for you.
hero.subtitle2: Reservations in seconds — appointments fully under your control.

features.subtitle: From the client’s first tap to your end-of-week numbers — Reserva handles the whole booking journey.

bookingPage.title: Your own booking page
bookingPage.text: Every salon gets a branded page at reserva.am — clients book in seconds, 24/7, no app to install.

calendar.title: Smart calendar
calendar.text: A drag-and-drop calendar that shows every specialist’s day. Reschedule with a single move.

team.title: Team & services
team.text: Manage specialists, services, prices and working hours — all from one clean backoffice.

notifications.title: Instant notifications
notifications.text: New bookings land in your dashboard the moment they happen. Optional Telegram alerts for owners.

multiLocation.title: Multi-location ready
multiLocation.text: Run several branches under one account. Clients pick a location right inside the booking flow.

revenue.title: Revenue at a glance
revenue.text: See bookings, occupancy and earnings in real time. Know exactly how your salon is performing.

howItWorks.subtitle: No technical setup on your side. We handle the heavy lifting so you can start taking bookings fast.

setup.title: We set you up
setup.text: Tell us about your salon. We create your branded booking page, add your services, team and hours.

book.title: Clients book online
book.text: Share your link. Clients pick a service, specialist and time — and the booking lands in your dashboard.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: Manage everything from one backoffice: confirm, reschedule, track revenue and grow with confidence.

pricing.subtitle: Simple volume pricing — the more specialists, the lower the rate. Every feature included.
pricing.calcDesc: Enter how many specialists you have to see your monthly total.
pricing.footnote: Prices in Armenian Dram (AMD). Billed monthly per active specialist. Cancel anytime — no setup or hidden fees.

ctaFooter.text: Set up in days and start your free 1-month trial today.
ctaFooter.tagline: The online reservation platform built for Armenian salons, barbershops and beauty studios.
